error.message: The requested operation is temporarily busy.

remediation.summary: A transcription of this session is running (the job in affected_ids) and holds this session root's share of the machine's capacity until it ends, so this command could not run. Nothing was committed. Retrying at once will not help: run the suggested job status command, and when it no longer reports the job running, run the same command again. A transcription of a long recording can take many minutes.
